queries_run: HOKA market share gaining OR losing 2026 On Running Deckers
UGG competitor new entrant threat 2026 Deckers

findings.claim: 公司 10-K 風險因子自述：面臨既有與新進入者競爭，HOKA 與 UGG 的能見度吸引了專攻這些品類的競爭者，離岸製造降低進入門檻，市占可能下滑。
findings.excerpt: We believe that the growth and visibility of our HOKA brand and UGG brand have attracted competitors specifically targeting the categories in which we operate. Barriers to entry have been reduced by access to offshore manufacturing and evolving technologies, allowing competitors to develop and scale products more quickly and at lower cost.

findings.claim: 公司 10-K 自述已經歷並預期持續面臨定價與促銷壓力，競爭者加大折扣可能迫使其降價或加促銷。
findings.excerpt: Consistent with these dynamics, we have experienced, and expect to continue to experience, pricing and promotional pressure across our brands and channels, particularly during periods of elevated industry inventory levels or inflationary pressure.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 搜尋摘要為二手轉述，無可逐字複製原文；HOKA 於美國路跑 $140 以上價位段份額上升（Circana，管理層引述）與 On 為主要挑戰者、Bernstein Underperform 以 clues 列出待程式核原文。

clues.claim: 管理層引 Circana：HOKA 於美國路跑 $140 以上價位段份額於 2025 年 10–12 月三個月顯著上升並居首。
clues.source: Yahoo Finance Deckers Q3 FY2026 earnings call

clues.claim: Bernstein 給予 Deckers Underperform、目標價 $100，認為休閒鞋品類趨於萎縮。
